title: Typical design criteria for sizing mesophilic anaerobic sludge digesters
markdown:
| Parameters | Low Rate Digestion | High Rate Digestion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Volatile Solids Loading Rate, kgVSS/day/m³ | 0.6 - 1.6 | 1.6 - 6.4 |
| Solids Retention Time, days | (*) | 10 - 20 |
| Hydraulic Retention Time, days | 30 - 40 | 10 - 20 |
notes: Printed note below the table is inside the region and kept with it: 'Note:  (*) Computation of actual SRT is difficult as it depends on the capacity utilization.'

The table prints 'kgVSS/day/m³' with no space between kg and VSS and with a superscript 3, while the running text immediately above prints '(kg VSS/day/m3)' with a space and a plain 3. Both forms kept as printed; not harmonised.
The Low Rate Digestion cell for Solids Retention Time prints only the asterisk reference '(*)' and no value; it is not filled in from the printed note or from Table 6.9.
Range values print as '0.6 - 1.6', '1.6 - 6.4', '30 - 40' and '10 - 20' with a spaced hyphen; reproduced as printed.
Header row prints the column titles as 'Low Rate Digestion' and 'High Rate Digestion' with no unit row beneath.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of 144 dpi annotation-cleaned full-page PNGs plus 250-450 dpi detail crops of each item; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only, recovered from the timed-out sew-t08 batch and re-checked against the page images. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No verification.visual_recheck and no seal.
